Description: CUDA-version agnostic components of NVIDIA® Datacenter GPU Manager (DCGM)
 This package provides
     - the core DCGM shared library (libdcgm.so.4)
     - the standalone executable wrapper for the DCGM shared library
       (nv-hostengine)
     - a systemd service that manages an nv-hostengine process (nvidia-dcgm)
     - plugins implementing various components of DCGM functionality
 .
 .
 This package is a component of DCGM, a userspace library and service that
 simplifies the administration of NVIDIA datacenter hardware in cluster and
 datacenter environments.
 .
 DCGM functionality includes:
     - Configuration management for NVIDIA GPU and NvSwitch hardware
     - Active health diagnostics for NVIDIA GPU hardware
     - Passive health monitoring for NVIDIA GPU and NvSwitch hardware
     - Device-level profiling metrics for NVIDIA CPU, GPU, and NvSwitch hardware
     - Job-level execution and performance statistic aggregation and analysis
       for NVIDIA GPU hardware
     - Callback registration for user-configured action and/or notification upon
       detection of hardware faults

     - Callback registration for user-configured action and/or notification upon
       detection of hardware faults

Description: CUDA-version agnostic components of NVIDIA® Datacenter GPU Manager (DCGM)
 This package provides
     - the core DCGM shared library (libdcgm.so.4)
     - the standalone executable wrapper for the DCGM shared library
       (nv-hostengine)
     - a systemd service that manages an nv-hostengine process (nvidia-dcgm)
     - plugins implementing various components of DCGM functionality
 .
 .
 This package is a component of DCGM, a userspace library and service that
 simplifies the administration of NVIDIA datacenter hardware in cluster and
 datacenter environments.
 .
 DCGM functionality includes:
     - Configuration management for NVIDIA GPU and NvSwitch hardware
     - Active health diagnostics for NVIDIA GPU hardware
     - Passive health monitoring for NVIDIA GPU and NvSwitch hardware
     - Device-level profiling metrics for NVIDIA CPU, GPU, and NvSwitch hardware
     - Job-level execution and performance statistic aggregation and analysis
       for NVIDIA GPU hardware
     - Callback registration for user-configured action and/or notification upon
       detection of hardware faults

Description: NVIDIA® Datacenter GPU Manager (DCGM) proprietary binaries for CUDA11 systems
 This package provides binaries used by the subset of DCGM active health
 diagnostics distributed as part of the datacenter-gpu-manager-4-proprietary
 package for systems with a CUDA11 user-mode driver.
 .
 This package is a component of DCGM, a userspace library and service that
 simplifies the administration of NVIDIA datacenter hardware in cluster and
 datacenter environments.
 .
 DCGM functionality includes:

     - Active health diagnostics for NVIDIA GPU hardware
     - Passive health monitoring for NVIDIA GPU and NvSwitch hardware
     - Device-level profiling metrics for NVIDIA CPU, GPU, and NvSwitch hardware

     - Callback registration for user-configured action and/or notification upon

Description: IMEX Manager for NVIDIA based systems
 An IMEX domain is either an OS instance or a group of securely connected OS
 instances using the NVIDIA IMEX daemon. An IMEX channel is a global resource
 within the IMEX domain that represents a logical entity that aims to provide
 fine grained accessibility control for the participating processes. When
 exporter and importer CUDA processes have been granted access to the same IMEX
 channel, they can securely share memory.
 .
 The nvidia-modprobe CLI provides more information regarding setting up of IMEX
 channels.
